This is a great little game, but the environments are too few and too small. I really wish this had just been DLC for the original Liftoff even if it had cost the same. …

This game is perfect if you want to avoid having to explain to your wife why you need to buy a new drone because the last one got stuck in a 10-meter tall tree. Again. Hypothetically speaking, of course.

- No list of which environment is easy/medium/hard - Each environment only has 3 tracks - Even less graphics configuration options compared to Liftoff - No button for random track. Only restart the same track or start a "new session". …
